entities.summary: Serhiy Ivanovych Kot was a Ukrainian historian. A senior researcher at the Institute of History of Ukraine of the National Academy of Sciences of Ukraine, he focused on preservation of historical and cultural property, history of conservation and burial work in Ukraine, cultural property return and restitution. He was a member of the history museum's board, and was awarded the title Merited Culture Worker of Ukraine.
